cards.card_text: Now the LORD looks ahead to "that day," and He talks about the fallen tent of David, Israel's king.
cards.verse_text: “In that day I will restore the fallen tent of David. I will repair its gaps, restore its ruins, and rebuild it as in the days of old,

cards.card_text: James quotes Amos 9:11-12, where the Lord says, "After this I will return and rebuild the fallen tent of David." He says He'll rebuild its ruins and restore it.
cards.verse_text: ‘After this I will return and rebuild the fallen tent of David. Its ruins I will rebuild, and I will restore it,
